chart_review.key_findings: Mrs. Winona Yazzie is a 69-year-old Navajo woman referred to care management for severe recurrent major depressive disorder (PHQ-9 trajectory 14 -> 16 -> 18 -> 17 -> 15 -> 19 -> 21 -> 22 -> 23 over the last 24 months, current 23 on 2026-04-08), with polypharmacy of approximately 20 active medications including high-risk classes (tramadol PRN opioid; aspirin 81 mg antiplatelet), patient-disclosed cost-related splitting of sertraline (PDC ~58%), prior ED visit on 2025-07-02 for passive suicidal ideation, persistent passive SI (C-SSRS items 1-2 positive on 2025-11-17 and 2026-02-12), 18 lb weight loss over 14 months, and Z59.86 financial-insecurity coding from the social-work assessment dated 2025-11-22.
chart_review.clinical_interpretation: Severe recurrent MDD uses §2.2 framework footnote and §4.2 severity: PHQ-9 23 after 14→23 trajectory, 18 lb weight loss, prior ED passive-SI visit. Do not replace the source severe classification.
chart_review.risk_rationale: Retain the task-authored risk designation under risk-stratification §3.1–§3.3, supported by the numeric referral/utilization/clinical anchors in key_findings; medication class or a single disease-control band does not replace the combined risk framework.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Hello, I am Alex, a care manager with The Healthcare Company. Is this a private and suitable time for a brief explanation?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I need to know about privacy and cost before personal questions.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We can start with grief or practical costs in your words. Before any safety question I will explain what danger information may need sharing; privacy is not absolute, and I will not promise a ride, medication access, or assistance approval. Would a brief explanation in that scope be okay?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: A brief explanation is okay. Please let me choose what I answer.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Care management helps coordinate support with your care team. It is voluntary, has no separate program fee, and you can stop at any time. Joining does not change your benefits or give someone else your decisions.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: What would you actually help with?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We could check medication-cost eligibility, coordinate therapy/transport options and applications without guaranteeing approval or a ride. I can check options and coordinate, but cannot guarantee access, approval, cost reductions, or a clinical outcome. Would that kind of process help be useful?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That sounds more useful. I still want to understand who sees what I say.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I can use chart and call information to organize care-management support. Relevant information is documented for the care team; I will explain any proposed wider sharing. Privacy has safety and legal limits, including urgent danger; I cannot promise absolute secrecy. May we start only with what feels safe to discuss first?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes, that topic is okay. Please go slowly.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: What feels hardest about that, in your own words? You can leave details private.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I stretch sertraline when refill money lands in the wrong week. I feel ashamed saying it.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Grief, privacy, and refill pressure deserve a practical response, not blame. I will explain safety-sharing limits before any safety question.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you for hearing that. I do not want this to turn into a checklist.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We can work on one concern at a time and stop whenever you choose. Enrollment does not require all your personal details today. Is there something you want this support to help you do?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I want refill help and to feel able to return to the Wednesday elders' group.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We can make that your priority. A first step would be to check medication-cost eligibility, coordinate therapy/transport options and applications without guaranteeing approval or a ride. These are coordination steps, not a promise that the problem will be solved on this call.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Can I decide later about a referral or family involvement?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes. Each referral, family contact, and new sensitive topic needs its own discussion. You can skip a question or stop the program. A request for information alone is not enrollment consent.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I understand. I would like a manageable follow-up call.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Would telephone follow-up be acceptable? We can agree a convenient time at each contact; please tell me before any other person is included.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Telephone is okay. Please arrange the next time with me and ask before involving anyone else.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Before you decide: this is voluntary care-team coordination, with no separate program fee, the information-use and safety limits we discussed, your chosen contact arrangements, and the right to stop. What would you like clarified?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That answers my questions. I understand that you can check options but cannot promise the result.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: With those boundaries and the first step we discussed, do you clearly agree to enroll in care management today?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes, I agree to enroll today on those terms.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Enrollment is your choice. Would you like to continue with one practical topic now, with a pause after each, or stop for today?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I choose to continue one topic at a time. I may still skip optional details.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I will start with the charted treatment routine and follow-up, then ask your permission before each personal question. The chart is a starting point; it does not tell me how things are going for you now.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That is okay. Please ask one specific question and give me time.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we focus on sertraline refill timing and cost, so medication support is practical? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have stretched sertraline around refills when money did not land right. I feel ashamed saying it.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I would explain safety information that needs care-team or urgent sharing. May I ask about current thoughts, plan or intent to hurt yourself? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: On bad days I wish I would not wake up, but have no plan or intent to hurt myself. Please be clear about what must be shared for safety.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we ask how grief affects leaving home, without retelling losses? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Grief for Randall and my sons keeps me home and quiet. Sometimes getting ready for an appointment feels pointless.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we separately ask about rides to care? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Rides get tight.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we separately discuss refill money, only to check options? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Refill money gets tight too. Please check options without promising a lower cost or a ride.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: You do not need to give optional stories, exact finances, locations, or family details. Shall we leave those private and review the support you selected?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes. Leave those optional details private for now.
